label: JUNO 207-day atmospheric mass-splitting fits
summary: The September 2026 JUNO analysis reported 8,294 inverse-beta-decay candidates in 207.2 live days at an average 52.5 km reactor baseline and obtained different fitted atmospheric mass splittings under normal and inverted ordering using a Daya Bay constraint.

sources.title: Measurement of Neutrino Oscillation Parameters at JUNO and Indication of the Neutrino Mass Ordering

label: JUNO solar oscillation-parameter estimates
summary: The September 2026 JUNO analysis reported sin²θ12=0.3036±0.0064 and Δm21²=(7.388±0.078)×10^-5 eV², with stated relative precisions of 2.1% and 1.1%, respectively.

sources.title: Measurement of Neutrino Oscillation Parameters at JUNO and Indication of the Neutrino Mass Ordering

label: JUNO combined ordering indication and Bayes factor
summary: The September 2026 JUNO collaboration reported that incorporating long-baseline accelerator constraints on Δm31² favored normal over inverted neutrino mass ordering with one-sided significance of at least 2.1σ across CP-violating phases and a Bayesian Bayes factor of 10.18.

sources.title: Measurement of Neutrino Oscillation Parameters at JUNO and Indication of the Neutrino Mass Ordering

label: KATRIN effective electron-antineutrino mass bound
summary: KATRIN reported a fitted squared effective electron-antineutrino mass of -0.14 (+0.13/-0.15) eV² from five tritium beta-decay campaigns and an effective-mass upper limit of 0.45 eV at 90% confidence using 259 measurement days and 36 million electrons.

sources.title: Direct neutrino-mass measurement based on 259 days of KATRIN data

label: KamLAND-Zen xenon-136 neutrinoless-decay half-life limit
summary: The KamLAND-Zen full-dataset search with 745 kg enriched xenon and 2.1 tonne-years of xenon-136 exposure, combined with its previous phase, reported a 90%-confidence lower bound on the neutrinoless double-beta half-life of 3.8×10^26 years.

sources.title: Search for Majorana Neutrinos with the Complete KamLAND-Zen Dataset

label: KamLAND-Zen nuclear-model-dependent effective Majorana bound
summary: The KamLAND-Zen full-dataset report translated its neutrinoless xenon-136 double-beta half-life constraint into effective Majorana neutrino-mass upper limits ranging from 28 to 122 meV using phenomenological nuclear matrix-element calculations.

sources.title: Search for Majorana Neutrinos with the Complete KamLAND-Zen Dataset

label: Planck 2018 plus BAO neutrino mass-sum bound
summary: The Planck 2018 cosmological-parameter analysis reported Σmν<0.12 eV as a 95% upper limit when combined with baryon acoustic oscillation data in its base spatially flat ΛCDM framework.

label: DESI DR2 neutrino sum bound changes with dark-energy model
summary: The DESI DR2 analysis reported a 95% upper limit Σmν<0.064 eV for DESI BAO plus CMB under ΛCDM, versus Σmν<0.16 eV under a time-evolving w0wa dark-energy model using the same stated combination.

sources.title: DESI DR2 Results II: Measurements of Baryon Acoustic Oscillations and Cosmological Constraints

label: DESI DR2 neutrino mass tension and boundary-sensitive inference
summary: The DESI DR2 neutrino-constraints analysis reported a Feldman-Cousins 95% bound Σmν<0.053 eV after correcting for the zero-mass boundary, below the oscillation-inferred lower limit, and a separate effective-mass parametrization yielding 3σ tension under its analysis assumptions.

sources.title: Constraints on Neutrino Physics from DESI DR2 BAO and DR1 Full Shape

label: Planck 2018 BAO mass bounds change under hierarchy priors
summary: A Bayesian reanalysis using Planck 2018 CMB plus BOSS DR12, MGS and 6dFGS BAO data reported 95%-confidence neutrino mass-sum limits of 0.12 eV (degenerate masses), 0.15 eV (normal ordering) and 0.17 eV (inverted ordering), attributing their differences to mass-sum priors.

sources.title: Updated results on neutrino mass and mass hierarchy from cosmology with Planck 2018 likelihoods

label: DESI and CMB neutrino constraints with isocurvature allowed
summary: A 2026 joint CMB, DESI DR2 and supernova analysis reported that allowing a neutrino-density isocurvature mode shifted its 95% neutrino mass-sum limits from 0.052 to 0.057 eV under ΛCDM and 0.111 to 0.115 eV under dynamical dark energy, without detecting the isocurvature mode.

sources.title: Constraints on the Sum of Neutrino Masses from ACT DR6 and DESI DR2 Considering Isocurvature Initial Conditions

label: Hierarchy-aware prior relaxes cosmological mass-sum bound
summary: The 2026 cosmological isocurvature analysis reported that its purely adiabatic ΛCDM upper limit of 0.052 eV lay below the oscillation-implied normal-ordering minimum of 0.05878 eV because of a statistical prior extending to zero, while a hierarchy-informed prior raised the reported upper limit to 0.092 eV.

sources.title: Constraints on the Sum of Neutrino Masses from ACT DR6 and DESI DR2 Considering Isocurvature Initial Conditions
